item.title: World Quantum Cannes Festival to Bring Quantum Industry Leaders Together in November
item.summary: Insider Brief Press release – A new event on the world stage, the World Quantum Cannes Festival on Nov. 17 and 18, aims to create a global hub of quantum industrialization in one of Europe’s most prestigious locations, the Palais des Festivals in Cannes, France. The inaugural event already has secured more than 100 high-level quantum business and industry speakers […]
